source_records.positive: Official annual memory index names years 1980-2024, including a combined entry for 2014 and 2015; memories describe the exercise year and consultative activity.
source_records.limitation: Separate annual PDFs are retrospective editions, NOT time-stamped case-level register entries, revision snapshots, or complete Congress writings. Publication year need not equal coverage year.

source_records.positive: The annual source's indexed text states 2027 consultations entered the Council in calendar year 2024, a separate source-family intake count from the approved-dictamen search. The number is reported, NOT independently replayed or confirmed from original bytes.
source_records.limitation: No source-level case identifiers, arrival dates of each consulta, all-case pagination, independent issuer census, raw PDF checksum, or authenticated first_public_at. No outgoing outcomes extracted.

source_records.positive: The official index explicitly links 2017 and 2018 reports separate from annual full memories. A second documentary series exists, but not a version archive of one dataset.
source_records.limitation: Not a guarantee of an independent register census, common denominators or identical category definitions between reports and memories.

source_records.positive: Official transparency page lists distinct dates, commission or plenary, ministry and CE dictamen reference, with a link to older entries.
source_records.limitation: Conditioned on having been dispatched; excludes consultations still pending and can repeat case numbers across revisions. No independent total or first-publication witness. No case texts or statuses extracted.

source_records.positive: Council describes its own role, consulted subject matters and internal section-to-commission/plenary sequence, linking to the BOE-hosted dictamen base.
source_records.limitation: Selected by issuance of an opinion; website opening failed with 403. Not a pre-opinion input register and not a Congress initiative register.

source_records.publisher: Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado y Consejo de Estado
source_records.positive: Official BOE form states coverage of approved dictamens from 23 Apr 1987 through 8 Oct 2026 (as displayed on 31 Oct 2026); filters by expediente, procedencia, approval date and associated disposition BOE date.
source_records.limitation: No evidence of a bulk open-data API, source-history snapshots or inclusion of still-pending consultations. Database search total must not replace number of consultations entering Council.

source_records.publisher: Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado
source_records.positive: Help documents 50 items/page by default, max 10000 displayed results, sortable asc/desc, fields of number of expediente assigned to a consulta and approval date.
source_records.limitation: Cap 10000 is NOT an independent total of complete consultations, search pagination does not authenticate absence of unpublished/unissued cases, and BOE-date field refers to publication of related legal disposition, NOT dictamen first_public_at.

source_records.positive: Indexed official notice declares access/use of website implies express and full acceptance of conditions; grants information reuse under restrictions with private-use limits and exclusions for third-party intellectual property.
source_records.limitation: Specific Conseil-origin PDF contents or hosted third-party rights not independently adjudicated; web-open of notice failed 403. Did not accept terms or download full reports.

source_records.publisher: Agencia Estatal Boletín Oficial del Estado
source_records.positive: The 27 June 2024 general licence allows eligible reproduction/derivatives with attribution, preservation of meaning, source updates and no false official endorsement; binding by mere use as reusable material.
source_records.limitation: Excludes third-party IP and certain subcollections, requires case-specific confirmation for jointly hosted CE dictamens; accepting licence/bulk download outside scope of this run.

source_records.positive: Press text repeats that the 2024 memoir has been presented, and states the incoming consultation count for that year; the body contains a visible typo '2924', so the annual PDF is treated as the primary cited wording but not downloaded.
source_records.limitation: A press rephrasing is NOT independent verification of the Council's own original annual tally. No case-level entry identifiers or historical as-of metadata.

negative_findings.description: No new indexed official national feed was found in this scoped route that enumerates ALL Congress writings registered before Mesa with IDs, independent cohort total, complete preadmission status and bitemporal versions.
CE incoming consultations, dispatched matters and approved dictamens are distinct activity stages; none counts all legislative initiatives introduced in Congreso.
Memories published by exercise are historical annual reports, not archived per-item source vintages, and their publication timestamp is unverified.
BOE search includes approved dicta; consultations with no issued dictamen are not proven present. Search max 10000 is an output cap, not a complete population denominator.
BOE help's publication date is the related legal disposition's date, not original opinion release time or consultation receipt.
CE web notice binds users by site access/use; initial web open 403. General BOE licence has third-party carve-outs. No original source data downloads or licensing acceptance.
The public-indexed CE database is HTML search, not a documented XML/RSS/JSON endpoint exposing all incoming consultations. No endpoint URL was invented or tested.
No R8 attempt on /opendata/iniciativas 403, /datos-abiertos 403, static timestamped CSV 404, BOCG XIV-D637, MPR answered-only, conditioned Senate, authenticated Cortesía or imaginary Memoria XVI.
